newsitem.title: USA: Airgas to acquire Beard's Carbonic unit.
newsitem.headline: Airgas to acquire Beard's Carbonic unit.

text.p: Airgas Inc, a distributor of industrial gases, has signed a letter of intent to acquire Carbonic Reserves, an 85 percent owned subsidiary of Beard Co, the companies announced Monday.

Herb Mee, president of Beard, said that Beard expects to record a gain in the range of $10 to $11 million as a result of the sale. The sale is expected to result in the redemption of preferred stock in excess of $3.5 million, he added.
Mee said Beard will use a part of the proceeds to pay off its debt.

Carbonics, based in San Antonio, Texas, manufactures and distributes dry ice products. It has annual sales of approximately $14 million and operates six manufacturing plants, and 12 sales and distribution centers in Colorado, Kansas, New Mexico, Oklahoma, Texas and Wyoming.
Peter McCausland, chairman and chief executive officer of Airgas, said that Carbonic fits ideally with Airgas' previously announced strategy to expand in the CO2 business.
Closing of the transaction is conditioned upon, among other things, finalization and execution of an asset purchase agreement, approval by the boards and shareholders of the two companies.
Beard said its shareholders will be asked to approve the sale at their annual meeting scheduled on August 11.
Closing of the deal is expected by August 12, the companies said.
